title: The Last Bid

voice.name: Liam + Laura
voice.direction: Two distinct dry centered character performances: Liam as Jason, Laura as Lucia. Narration voices approved; these character castings are provisional and need performance listening review. No Lara substitution. Calm urgent turns; no overlap or lip-sync claim.

pov: two-character external POV: only what Jason and Lucia say or observe
hook: A thousand for a broken compass. That's our boat's compass. I know that cracked rim.
alternative_hooks: A broken compass nearly cost Jason somewhere to sleep.
Lucia stopped the bidding with one motel key.
alternative_hook_use: Replace scene 1 and re-time/recount the master before production; do not append.
script: A thousand for a broken compass. That's our boat's compass. I know that cracked rim. I know it too. I remember empty fuel, cold rain, and you promising we wouldn't gamble rent again. We left so much behind that night. Getting one piece back might make it feel different. Then hold this key. Our room is real. Its heater works. What direction does that compass even point? Nowhere. The needle's stuck. That man's bidding again. If I lower my paddle, he gets to keep it. He gets a broken compass. We get tonight, groceries, and a door we can close. Let him have it. All right. He's won. Keep the key, though. I'd rather carry the groceries. Does that heater sound terrible? Like thunder in a tin bucket. We'll complain about it all night. That's how we'll know we're home.
plot_mechanism: sentimental bidding versus keeping a shared promise

canon_status.fictional_elements: All events, dialogue, sets, props, circumstances and supporting extras are original non-canon fan fiction; no game footage or official story claims.
